name: Pressure Bloom Shelf
introDiscord:
Pressure Bloom Anemones cover the bones in enormous glowing flowers.

The graveyard has grown a garden.
introTwitch:
Pressure Bloom Anemones cover the bones in enormous glowing flowers.

The graveyard has grown a garden.

pressure-bloom-shelf-approach.prompt:
Three paths cross a field of blossoms growing directly from ancient
Leviathan remains.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's flower crown.

'Found prettiest part of graveyard.

Made crown.

Glimmer stole crown.

Recovered crown from rib.'

right.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath glowing petals.

forward.message:
A Pressure Bloom Anemone opens across the path.

The garden bites.

pressure-bloom-shelf-depths.prompt: Flowers spread across ribs and scales.

left.message: An Anemone closes around the route.

right.message:
Shizuki's medicine reads:

'Flower-related injuries.

Again.

Why do flowers keep doing this?'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the botanical emergency kit.

forward.message: A wrecked strongbox lies inside the bloomfield.

pressure-bloom-shelf-threshold.prompt:
Compressed Garden forms where enormous bones trap the water under
intense pressure.

left.message: Star Candies glitter beneath a Leviathan scale covered in flowers.

right.message: An Anemone unfolds between the petals.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle:

'Garden review:
beautiful.
dangerous.
excellent crown materials.
four stars.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the four-star garden medicine.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every smaller bloom closes.

One enormous flower remains open at the center of Compressed Garden.

Its petals begin turning toward you.

Use /yes to enter the Garden or /no to enjoy the flowers from the
traditional non-biting distance.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every smaller bloom closes.

One enormous flower remains open at the center of Compressed Garden.

Its petals begin turning toward you.

Use !yes to enter the Garden or !no to enjoy the flowers from the
traditional non-biting distance.

boss.revealText:
The enormous bloom tears open.

Crushpetal Sovereign reveals itself!

completionText:
The Sovereign closes.

The garden resumes glowing across the bones.

Still four stars.
